translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Wach mokor nibiro timore ne Babulon
Wach mokor kuom piny Ongoro manie dho Nam:

content.text: Mana kaka kalausi mager kudho koluwo piny man yo milambo,
e kaka joma monjou biro wuok e piny motwo, piny masira.
Fweny malich osenyisa ni:
Jandhoko biro ndhoko, to jayeko biro yeko.
Elam mondo omonje! Media mondo olwore koni gi koni!
Abiro tieko lit duto mane okelo.
Kaneno magi to apuodora ka rem rama e ringra,
rem rama mana ka dhako mamuoch kayo;
kibaji goya kuom gik mawinjo
kendo midhiero omaka kuom gik ma aneno.
Chunya bwok, denda tetni nikech luoro;
gombo ma an-go mondo piny imre oselokorena masira.
Negiiko mesa mondo gimethi kendo gichiem,
to apoya nono negipo kinyisogi,
ni mondo giik gigegi mag lweny.
“Dhiyo mondo iket jangʼicho
mondo odwok wach kuom gik moneno.
Ka oneno geche lweny miywayo gi farese,
gi joma oidho punde kata ngamia,
to oikre kendo obed motangʼ.”
“Yaye Ruoth Nyasacha pile ka pile asebedo kar ngʼicho,
kendo otieno asiko e kara mar tich.
Ero ngʼato biro koidho gach lweny miywayo gi farese.
To ngʼatno nowacho niya,
‘Babulon osepodho, adier osepodho,
adier osepodho,
kendo nyisechene manono osetur matindo tindo!’ ”
Yaye ogandana mosenyon piny
ka cham midino anyisou gima asewinjo koa kuom Jehova Nyasaye Maratego,
ma Nyasach Israel.

content: Wach mokor ni biro timore ne Edom

content.text: Ngʼato obiro ira koa Seir, kendo openja monwore niya,
“Jarito odongʼ seche adi mondo piny oru?
Jarito odongʼ seche adi mondo piny oru?”
Eka jarito nodwoko niya,
“Piny chiegni ru, to otieno bende biro chopo.
Kidwaro penjo, to penji kendo imed penjo.”

content: Wach mokor nibiro timore ne jo-Arabu

content.text: Un jo-Dedan ma jo-ohala mawuotho
ka gi kacha ka bworo e thim jo-Arabu,
keluru pi ne joma riyo oloyo,
to un mudak Tema,
keluru chiemo ne joma oseringo ka pondone lweny.
Giseringone ligangla,
ne ligangla mowuodhi,
ne atungʼ moywa kendo ne lweny mager.

content: Ruoth Nyasaye wachona niya, “Mana kaka ja-otongʼo kwano hike achiel ma tije rumogo e kaka duongʼ mar Kedar norum.
Joma nok ma gin jolweny mag asere ma gin thuondi man Kedar ema notony. Jehova Nyasaye ma en Nyasach Israel osewacho.”
